text: Loss by distance along the rollout: pixels near, statistics far, no observation late
description: Felix's question (2026-11-25): compare repeated application of the net with the real footage. Training already rolls out 8 steps (BPTT) and carries state up to 96 frames, but observe = 0.3 blends the real frame in every step, and exact pixels stop making sense far out (a hallucination should diverge; L1 then rewards blur). Change rollout(): pixel weight decays along the rollout (dominant for ~0.5 s), train.style weight rises; observe -> 0 after the first steps. Judge with evaluate.py's sharpness/contrast on 96 free-running frames.
